facts.fact: A WARDIP Guinea-Bissau post says the government approved the national interoperability regulation (quadro nacional de interoperabilidade), tied to the World Bank-backed WARDIP programme; the post gives no event date, so the published date 2026-08-08 is used.

systems.owner: Government of Guinea-Bissau (announced by WARDIP Guiné-Bissau)

note: No fact on use: the post does not say the regulation is compulsory, names no enforcing body and counts no bodies following it.

facts.fact: The WARDIP Guinea-Bissau publication page lists the consultants' deliverable (interoperability framework, interoperability platform and enterprise architecture) from a feasibility study to develop an interoperability framework, commissioned by WARDIP, the World Bank, ITMA and the telecommunications and digital economy ministry; the page does not say the framework was adopted, and the page carries no event date, so the published date (2025-11) is used.

note: Page is a short acknowledgement of the consultants; no statement of adoption or use.

facts.fact: WARDIP reports that the government approved the National Regulation on Interoperability of Digital Systems and Platforms of public and private services through Decree 27/2025, published in the Boletim Oficial of 31 October 2025, setting common technical standards so systems can exchange data.

note: No fact on use: the page does not say public bodies must follow the regulation, names no enforcing body and counts no bodies exchanging data under it.

slug: 2025-07-10 Guinea-Bissau Council of Ministers approves three digital decrees (interoperability, data governance, cybersecurity)

facts.fact: The state news agency ANG reports that the Council of Ministers approved the draft decree (Projeto de Decreto) on the Regulation on Interoperability of Systems and Digital Platforms of Public and Private Services; the article has no in-body date, so the date is the proxy published date.
facts.system: Regulamento sobre a Interoperabilidade de Sistemas e Plataformas Digitais

note: Draft approval only; nothing on compulsion or use.
